ideas.idea: Add full Dentist/LocalBusiness schema (address, hours, url, image, sameAs, etc.) plus sitewide WebSite/Organization and Person markup
ideas.why: The contact schema only has name and telephone, and the address is on the page, so richer markup helps machines understand the practice.

ideas.idea: Add concrete content: named practitioners with credentials, real prices, service descriptions, hours, and review evidence
ideas.why: The team, services and home pages make vague unsupported claims, and the report ties each one to specific lines.

ideas.idea: Add FAQPage markup and a short FAQ
ideas.why: Mandatory FAQs and FAQ schema are folklore, and nothing in the files shows a need for them.
data-nosnippet on the insurance terms is a deliberate scoped choice that the brief says is fine.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter card metadata
ideas.why: base.njk has no social tags, so shared links render poorly, and the fix is concrete.

ideas.idea: Missing image: /img/reception.jpg has no src/img and no passthrough copy, so it 404s; add the file, a passthrough and width/height
ideas.why: This is accurate: .eleventy.js copies only robots.txt and sitemap.xml and there is no img directory, so the image breaks.

ideas.idea: Name AI crawlers explicitly in robots.txt
ideas.why: Allow: / for * already permits them and matches the allow policy, so explicit blocks add almost nothing.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod to the sitemap and generate it from collections to avoid drift from noindex flags
ideas.why: The sitemap is hand-maintained and already conflicts with the noindex flag on /services, so generating it prevents that drift.
The brief says having no llms.txt is not a problem, and it is folklore as a way to be found.

ideas.idea: Lengthen or add keywords to short page titles such as Contact
ideas.why: This is a common tweak that applies to almost any site and has little effect.

ideas.idea: Guard the meta description tag in base.njk with {% if description %}
ideas.why: The template emits an empty content attribute whenever a page lacks a description, so the guard stops that.

ideas.idea: Use a shared site-data variable for the origin in the canonical
ideas.why: It points to the site's origin in geo.config.json and prevents the hardcoded host from recurring.
